deals.description: Three toques for Restaurant Rote Bar. ✨ Step inside and the evening begins to unfold. Deep red damask surrounds you, crystal chandeliers glow above large oil paintings, and somewhere in the room a piano starts to play. Every seat here has its own story, and yours begins with dinner in the Restaurant Rote Bar and ends just across the way, when the curtain rises at the Vienna State Opera. It is the kitchen of Anton Pozeg that gives these evenings their taste: Austrian classics, refined with regional ingredients and a great deal of respect for tradition. Now gaultmillau_austria has honoured it with a third toque, up from two. Thank you to our entire team, in the kitchen and in the dining room,
